children.value: > Fact From Story: We’re still in the very early days of the fediverse, and it’s going to be messy for a while.
> > Fact From Story: Some particularly thirsty influencers are going to go hard on cross-posting tools that threaten to clutter up all your feeds everywhere and become totally unavoidable.
> > Fact From Story: It might feel like you’re seeing the same posts too many times, and like you see some posts that obviously weren’t meant to be seen in the app or feed you’re using.
> > > Fact From Story: Some particularly thirsty influencers are going to go hard on cross-posting tools that threaten to clutter up all your feeds everywhere and become totally unavoidable.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: Cross-posting and seeing unintended content contribute to a feeling of messiness.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: Overlapping content and unavoidable posts contribute to a messy and cluttered user experience.
> Commonsense Knowledge: Early stages of development are typically associated with messiness and challenges.
